notes.title: Say hello to KOTC v1.3 “Morgrim”!
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43052267/8e661a4a0faefb2778e154d25d800da28bc1b837.png"][/img][/p][p]Oh hello, beloved Nobles. How are you? It's so, so nice to be back here.[/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1839880/view/668340807104725716?l=english"]As some of you may have already seen[/url] a change to Twitch's backend recently took down Twitch Mode for King of the Castle. We've knuckled down, fixed the issue and were ready to update the game with that fixed.[/p][p]As we promised in our "future of" blog post we're very much committed to supporting the game for as long as possible.[/p][p]And for the past for the past year and a bit our lovely community [url="https://discord.gg/xasJBFH2kR"]in the Discord[/url] have been faithfully spotting and reporting bugs in KOTC.[/p][p]This necessary update turned into a great excuse to come back, work through that list of bugs. As a result, we're happy to present a Proper Update filled with fixes galore![/p][p]We couldn't spare infinite time as we're currently also working on an update to [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3547010/Occlude"]Occlude[/url], our newest release, as well as tinkering on Other Secret Things, but we're hoping these fixes mean you can all enjoy King of the Castle for many more year and bits to come.[/p][p]All this to say - welcome to the MORGRIM update. So named after a much loved community member who faithfully collected and recorded all the little bugs that cropped up with King of the Castle. Thanks Morgrim, you deserve this.[/p][p]Right, enough waffle from me. Let's get into it![/p][p]  [/p][h2]The important fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Twitch Mode is now back up and working as intended.[/p][/*][*][p]You can no longer get invited to the Lord's Hunt if you've banned hunting. If no fun is allowed for your Nobles, well, no fun allowed for you.[/p][/*][*][p]Speaking of which, the game also didn't recognize when you banned hunting in the Lord's Hunt invite event. We've fixed that, so the 'No Fun Allowed' Achievement should be easier to get![/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a pronoun typo in the Boat Race which (fascinatingly) caused a softlock.[/p][/*][*][p]Hiring mercenaries to defend your roads can now lead to an event where they extort you for more money. We're trying to teach you the dangers of privately owned critical infrastructure, but this also caused locking issues in games.[/p][/*][*][p]If you fail the second stage of becoming a tyrant, the game entered an endless loop of telling you this rather than moving the story on. Funny, but fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]If any of the Regions needed to choose a new Scheme for whatever reason, the Sorcery option was missing from a few - This sometimes caused softlocks. That's also fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]In addition to the above, the Counts also had some bad syntax in their choosing new Schemes event. We've also also fixed that.[/p][/*][*][p]The Chiefs Prophecy scheme was nearly impossible as it was secretly looking for Kingdom's entire Faith to be down to 2. It's now just the Chief's Faith.[/p][/*][*][p]The Baron's Doppelganger scheme would try and read the Chief's Stat Goal and compare the Baron's Defiance level against it. Why? Great question. Anyway, this would cause soft locks if the Barons weren't in the game. Fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]We've stopped the Count's Intimidation scheme checking if the game is in Rebellion. I hilariously have the note next to this issue that [i]"Intimidation is peaceful"[/i] which I wanted to share.[/p][/*][*][p]Meanwhile, the Baron's Intimidation scheme was actually checking for Stability and not Authority. That's resolved.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]The mildly less important fixes[/h2][list][*][p]After resolving a haunted building with the Grand Inquisitor, the previously haunted Noble was nicking her line. Now, no more![/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a typo in the Strange Fossils event.[/p][/*][*][p]If your previous Monarch is drowned in a 'miraculous' flood of beer, the next Monarch's event won't just refer to them as "the (name of previous monarch)" but use their title.[/p][/*][*][p]Typo fixes to the Expedition to Chur event.[/p][/*][*][p]The offending Count is not called a "COCKRAOCH" in the Fire in the Palace event. That was a typo, not some mythical monster.[/p][/*][*][p]If unleashed in the palace fire events, Illarion then wanted to "ay waste" to you. He now wants to "lay waste" to you instead.[/p][/*][*][p]Also, letting Illarion out of his box now correctly leads to a new event.[/p][/*][*][p]If the Monster in the East event does kill a Noble, it will now actually count as a death. Previously they were declared as dead but were, in fact, absolutely fine. Pretty ineffectual monster all round.[/p][/*][*][p]If a combatant is using a spear in the Patrician's Games event, they will not randomly start using a sword instead. No dual wielding in the arena.[/p][/*][*][p]Also, swamp giants stop turning into sand giants halfway through the same event. No giant transfiguration in the arena.[/p][/*][*][p]Your Honour Guard would often steal lines from Nobles who introduce or interact with them. They're less chatty now.[/p][/*][*][p]A number of typos and text fixes across the Honour Guard events.[/p][/*][*][p]Completing the game by becoming a Saint and dying now correctly redefines your current spouse as the spouse of the previous Monarch. That one could get weird.[/p][/*][*][p]A swathe of typo fixes in the Rightful Heir event storylines.[/p][/*][*][p]Weirdly, in both the Counts and Chiefs scheme choice event, the "old ways" are actually spelt the "old wasy". Great name for a pub though, The Old Wasy.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes for incorrect timers and descriptions being displayed in the Grandee's Fervour scheme.[/p][/*][*][p]If you had the Chiefs and they picked the Sorcery scheme, their ending text was a little funky on certain occasions. Now, the correct soul is collected by the correct wizard, as well as the correct Noble is trapped in a bubble of silence for rest of their mortal life.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed typos in the Chief's Ragnarok scheme. [/p][/*][*][p]One of the many sorcery endings stops incorrectly trying to call your usurper a Chief. I mean, they probably were a Chief, knowing Chiefs, but that's beside the point.[/p][/*][*][p]Sweat no longer runs from your 'bow' when Oreid survives an assassination. It runs from your 'brow'. Very important to sweat correctly when your exiled advisor/lover with a gunship has a near death experience.[/p][/*][*][p]If the Mad Professor type offers to cure you of your Therianthropy for free, he now won't charge you an absolutely huge fee if you agree. Potentially good political commentary, but no, that was a mistake.[/p][/*][*][p]A wandering Wizard can now correctly wreck a Region's Military, build an army of spider-pirate hybrids to take over the Kingdom and animate smoke-monsters, all thanks to the power of typo fixing.[/p][/*][*][p]Your Useless Cousin's pronouns are respected in the Salon event. He may be useless, but that's zero excuse for being impolite to him.[/p][/*][*][p]Over 60 typos resolved across all five Loyalist Schemes. That took some serious time, well done to Harry.[/p][/*][/list][p]There are, as always, still other things we'd love to do for King of the Castle, but for the same reasons as we spoke about before, we can only do so much.[/p][p]We hope this update brings you a little joy regardless. Also if you haven't yet tried Occlude, [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3547010/Occlude"]why not check it out[/url]? It's really cool. [/p][p]Oh, and don't forget to join our Discord![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43052267/00aca297720d043572cb96efbca852b7f211c7d4.gif"][/img][/p][p]And finally a big thank you to you, our players.[/p][p]On a personal note it means so much that our strange little game of "Game of Thrones meets Monty Python" is still so loved.[/p][p]The team past and present worked extremely hard and every inch is filled with love and care. To have that reciprocated by you lot makes me genuinely emotional.[/p][p]That's enough soppy nonsense. Now go on, get. Go find some friends and execute them for treason, you little scamps.[/p][p]S[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1839880/King_Of_The_Castle"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Issues with Twitch Mode
notes.notes:
[p]UPDATE 28th August 2025:[/p][p]Apologies all, we've come across some issues in porting our shaders into the new version. We're trying to resolve this before we go live. We'll let you all know when it's good & ready![/p][p]Thanks again for your patience and apologies,
Sam[/p][p][/p][p]UPDATE 20th August 2025:[/p][p]Hi everyone,[/p][p]An update with a fix for Twitch Mode will be released on 27th August. There's a lot of testing to do with King of the Castle and we want to be confident in the quality of the update before we release it. Apologies that there will be a little more of a wait. 
In addition to fixing Twitch Mode, the update will include over 100 fixes to events in the game, including around 10 potential soft-locks. [/p][p]Thanks again for your patience!
Owen[/p][p][/p][p]ORIGINAL POST:[/p][p]Hi all,[/p][p]High speed update here to let you that Twitch Mode is going to be out of operation for some time.[/p][p]This is due to an update made by Twitch, who decommissioned non-secure WebSocket connections to Twitch IRC servers over the weekend. If you're interested, [url="https://discuss.dev.twitch.com/t/decommission-of-non-secure-websocket-connections-to-twitch-irc-servers/64142"]you can read more about it here[/url].[/p][p]We were using an older WebSocket connection to connect to Twitch IRC which sadly has been hit by this change.[/p][p]We're working on this updating King of the Castle so it'll work with the new system but that may take some time. Please bear with us![/p][p]Our Party Games are unaffected by this change - If you wanted to play in Twitch Mode, we suggest hosting a Party Game and sharing the code with your viewers.[/p][p]We'll update this post when Twitch Mode is up and running again.[/p][p]S[/p]

notes.title: Introducing our second title: OCCLUDE
notes.notes:
[h3][i]The past can be rewritten. You just have to play your cards right.[/i][/h3]

We're excited to announce Tributary Game's next title, OCCLUDE, to KOTC fans, with our new teaser trailer and secrets to discover - If you are brave enough to find them...

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3547010/Occlude

Occlude is a ritual disguised as Solitaire; a cosmic-horror card game where the rules are obscured and reality is at stake. Play through cryptic challenges to reveal forbidden lore in this singleplayer narrative puzzle game for the terminally curious.

[b]Don’t worry; you can always start over.[/b]

Fans of King of the Castle's world-building, narrative rewards in secret paths, and unapologetic uniqueness will love our next title, Occlude. It's a different type of game, but one we know will delight and frustrate you in equal parts.

We're also excited to be partnering with [url=https://www.pantaloon.io/games]Pantaloon[/url]! Their mission is to "offer a pedestal to the bold and bizarre, and create a home for misfits", which describes Tributary and the games we make perfectly. 

We've been huge fans of their work to date, and are very proud to join them as they step into publishing alongside other superb titles.

If you want to know more about Occlude, you'll have to find it - Breadcrumbs hidden throughout today’s announcements lead to rewards. Hidden channels in our Discord, our first Occlude lore reveal and much more can be all be yours.

notes.title: The future of King of the Castle
notes.notes:
Since we unleashed [b]King of the Castle[/b] on an unsuspecting public back in March, we’ve been overwhelmed and humbled by the response. 

The streams, the massive public games, the enthusiasm from our Discord, the friendships made along the way (and in some cases, broken due to squabbling over a certain bear)… It’s been an extraordinary journey.

So first of all, a heartfelt thanks to all of you who have played. I can’t express how much everyone here at Tributary appreciates you - and we hope you had as good a time as we did!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43052267/47d72b40bf8a3d2d639090e8bb0748cd7d19b9ed.png[/img]

But all journeys have to come to an end. Or, at least, to a point where you put up your feet and rest a while.

Although we’re happy with King of the Castle as it stands, we’d love to keep expanding it forever. But for various reasons, this simply isn’t feasible, so there won’t be any more major updates. 

That being said, there will be occasional small updates in the future… Just don’t expect massive new features or game-changing mechanics. We will, of course, continue to fix bugs and provide support.

We love you all, our amazing fans. Thanks for everything. Making games is what we do at Tributary and we hope you’re excited for what's next - the second we have something to share, we’ll let you know!

If you want to follow what Tributary Games gets up to in the future, [url=https://www.tributary.games/whats-next]sign up to our new newsletter here[/url].

notes.title: 1.2 Update “Democracy Manifest” is out now!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43052267/e556d6dd946e66553d0404b499a1ed1e9f54abac.png[/img]

Greetings, Your Many Majesties, and thank you for your patience! We at Tributary have been busy working on the biggest King of the Castle patch to date. We're royally grateful to all of you who've been playing the game, giving us feedback, and sending messages [url=https://discord.gg/xasJBFH2kR]in the Discord[/url]. 

We’ve been listening to your feedback. This latest update - DEMOCRACY MANIFEST - adds some key new features to King of the Castle that have been in demand for a long, long time!

If you’re excited by this and want to see more from us in the future - [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1839880/King_Of_The_Castle/]leave a review![/url] It helps our game reach even more people, which in turn opens up the possibility of even more updates for KOTC. In the truest spirit of democracy, we can only do this with your help.

[h2]King of the Castle v1.2 “Democracy Manifest” includes[/h2]

[h3]Three new Schemes, including Loyalist:[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43052267/030011ce4b74ba1fc8ea9aadf33359e649aa3ca5.gif[/img]

LOYALIST - Why scheme when you can team? If a region wins the game, then in the next reign they can now opt to support their favoured [strike]puppet[/strike] Monarch instead of scheming against them. But be careful - voting for the Loyalist option can backfire if you and the Monarch start to clash...

UPRISING - Get the people on your side! The Monarch has always been able to win the game by rallying the commonfolk, but now for the first time the Nobles have the same power. In the Uprising scheme, you can stoke a revolution and attack the very foundations of the Monarchy itself!

SORCERY - Recruit a wizard to your cause! In the Sorcery scheme, each region can now bribe a wizard to help them win the throne - and every region has a different wizard available for recruitment. This is the first all-region scheme to offer a completely unique ending depending on which region completes it!

[h3]Premium Nobles Region selection[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43052267/d832426035b8439311a61f8d0c15e3efaab5e46e.gif[/img]

Premium Nobles (a.k.a. anyone who owns the game) can now choose which region they want to join on game startup! This feature works in both Party Games and on Twitch.

For those concerned about unbalanced teams, we got you - The Monarch can also re-balance the Regions before starting the game with a click of the button.

This was by far the most-demanded feature from our audience, and we're very pleased to add it in now. It was technically difficult, but we’re excited with the result.

For design purposes, this is only available at the start of a New Dynasty - otherwise it would encourage team-switching as soon as one region started to fall behind in their scheme! We've also made it exclusive to players who own the game because this feature increases our server load considerably.

Also, there are a bunch of secret commands on Twitch that can be used instead of the standard region name. Comment below if you’ve discovered any!

[h3]Larger, easier to read screens[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43052267/f3fad7f3bc57cf4ef108a23d296a6faa305da979.gif[/img]

Tired of eye-strain? So are we! We've improved readability across all the UI, so our poor phone-users can put down their magnifying glasses.

This includes larger Challenge icons, resizing of text and choices in Events, larger Stat icons in Votes and a considerably larger choice section in the initial setup of a Vote.

[h3]40 new Shields[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43052267/16e002a5569dcccf412d17c3eef1d9935a83ae1a.gif[/img]

We've added a fleet of new shield designs, including 19 contributed by streamers!

[h3]New music from Hassan DuRant[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43052267/35f97b63c6a2075a9aff7f6c6de3f018b70e7ba9.png[/img]

Several amazing new backing tracks have been added to the game, courtesy of our wonderful musician [url=https://www.hadurant.com/]Hassan DuRant[/url]. 

We’ve also made the intro idents a touch quieter. No longer do horns blast your headphones off your head as soon as you reach the startup screen.

We’re working on releasing a soundtrack for the game but this is currently being mastered - please bear with us!

[h3]New events[/h3]

A raft of new content has also been added to the game for 1.2, including:
[list]
[*] Jailbreak - a full event chain kicked off when one of your imprisoned Nobles breaks out of prison and goes on a classic revenge rampage.
[*] Old Leaders - a dynasty event chain centering around the knock-on effects of rebellions from prior reigns.
[*] The Rightful Heir - another dynasty event chain, this time featuring the previous Monarch's Heir coming back to haunt you! 
[/list]
And a bunch of smaller new events, including...
[list]
[*] Hunting Ban Repeal
[*] Stage Fright
[*] Shaky Foundations
[*] Bear Death
[*] Fishy Heritage
[/list]

[h3]Quality of life[/h3]
[list]
[*] Players may change their pronouns after joining on Twitch
[*] Premium player banners showing in Votes, Game Over, Overview and Richest Noble
[*] Social buttons on news portal
[*] Text for number of Nobles in the game now a button that takes players to Noble List
[*] Improvements to the web app for Party Mode
[/list]

[h3]Bugfixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Typo fix in the first battle of the rebellion
[*] Correct name of town in Jousting event
[*] PLANTNAME variable in Exotic Plant is now correctly parsed
[*] Fix to soft lock in Split Tournament
[*] Fix to wrong speaker reference in Rogue Golem
[*] Wealth update in Boat Race fixed
[*] Fix to rare soft lock in Guards event
[*] Fix for doubled Nobles in Strange Fossils
[*] Fix to Barons Intimidation end stage scheme event sometimes not firing
[*] Can now only offer concessions to Kirth if your treasury is high enough
[*] Various other typo fixes
[*] Balance fixes
[/list]

[h3]NOTICE: Price increase on the 24th[/h3]

We hope you enjoy the update! One more thing, however...

The current low, low price point is great for KOTC, but as we continue to support and expand the game it has become difficult to justify. We hate to do this, but we're going to [b]increase the price[/b] on July 24th, bumping it up to [b]$9[/b] (or your regional equivalent).

Before you grab your torches and pitchforks and launch an Uprising scheme against us, please know that this is necessary for the game's long-term survival, and we've only done this after a lot of painful consideration. 

Also, you still have 2 weeks to buy a copy before the price hike. So tell your friends! Grab a copy of KOTC now! And sharpen your daggers - you'll want them nice and ready for the new schemes...

notes.title: Sneak peek at King of the Castle 1.2: Democracy Manifest!

What a month it's been! Our first update, "Good to be King", has been a great success, we're currently in LudoNarraCon and soon will be at A MAZE, and we're also sitting pretty at a [b]whopping 94% positive on Steam![/b]. 

Thank you all so much for playing, enjoying and reviewing the game; We've been genuinely blown away by your love and support. However, we're not resting on our laurels...

In fact, we're pleased to announce the next update for King of the Castle, "Democracy Manifest", will be [b]coming out in early June[/b] of this year.

For Democracy Manifest, we've been working hard at some much requested features as a priority for the game. Let's have a little sneak peek inside...

[h2]Premium Nobles will be able to choose their Region![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43052267/29b862a77d44ca3bd243bfbeaed72aca2b6d3df1.png[/img]

One of the most repeated and strident requests is for Nobles to be able to choose which Region they join. We're extremely pleased to say we've done the hard work behind the scenes to allow for this in both Party Games and Twitch Mode!

There will be some caveats for design purposes: This will be available for Premium players only and only be available at the start of new Dynasties. We're in the early testing phase of this feature and we'll be able to share more about how this works soon.

[h2]New Schemes, including a Loyalist Scheme[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43052267/e4652c721b95fed5ddb60b6dd91e5d51880e5413.png[/img]

We're also hard at work on new Schemes, one of which is the much requested Loyalist scheme. Winning Regions will be able to choose this special Scheme at the start of a Dynasty game, which will require them to defeat the other Region's Scheme to win.

They will still be able to rebel and crown their Claimant if the Monarch dies prematurely, as well as get special Events to assist the Monarch as, for the first time in King of the Castle, truly loyal Nobles.

We're now testing the Loyalist Scheme for balance purposes; It really does add a different vibe to games, and we're keen to make sure that it doesn't unbalance small games.

[h2]New Shields, new Twitch drops and more...[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43052267/d59c49004c5ee7e4c1dcd14d21f77728ff357e49.png[/img]

With the help of some of our favourite streamers, we've been working on new Noble shields for the game! These have been added as a thank you to our Twitch community, who we owe so much to.

There will also be new Twitch drops, new Events (both solo and Dynasty), a rework of the UI in the game for readability, and even more to be announced soon.

Expect this update out in early June and in the meantime, if you haven't already, go grab King of the Castle, as it's on a 10% Steam Sale for LudoNarraCon, then [url=bit.ly/lnc23]check out the rest of the festival here[/url].

notes.title: 1.1 Update “Good to be King” is out now!
notes.notes:
We’re extremely excited to announce that our first post-launch update, [b]GOOD TO BE KING[/b] is out today!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43052267/32d4617a4676fec9df58a9d9fbba2fa2791f7e57.png[/img]

By listening to your feedback and sifting through our analytics, we’re pleased to say our first update addresses many of the biggest requests we’ve had from our players. 

We’re a small team working on a very limited budget, so we’ve had to prioritize some features over others, but we see this as a big step for King of the Castle.

We’d also like to thank players who’ve left us their reviews. We’re at the cusp of hitting [b]Overwhelmingly Positive,[/b] which would be - as well as a huge boost to the Steam algorithm - an immense honour for us devs.

If you’d like to help spread the word about King of the Castle, please consider leaving a review!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1839880/King_Of_The_Castle

[h2]King of the Castle v1.1 “Good To Be King” includes:[/h2]

[h3]Buffs for the Monarch[/h3]
All our feedback and analytics showed that the game was too hard for most Monarchs. We’ve made changes to ensure that both Monarchs and Nobles get a chance of winning.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43052267/ec886f59ee169a17658a131f4d01c86e0b84f9d8.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]New Taxation Screen[/b] - Reward loyalty, punish errant Regions and control Defiance by setting different taxes or all-new bribes! Choose between Cruel Tax, Common Tax and Bribes for each Region individually.
[*] Laws of the Land now appear at the end of the first Season, giving Monarchs earlier access to the tools that help them manipulate votes
[*] We’ve [b]shortened the Ambition by one step[/b], removing the redundant setup event that had no gameplay impact. This makes the overall game quicker and punchier as well as helping Monarchs to the finish line.
[*] Rebellions are now harder to push over the line, with 70% of active Nobles in a Region required to rebel.
[*] To help out beginners, we’ve added text that explains the next step for Monarchs in Ambition Events.
[*] We’ve tweaked 4-6 player games and re-balanced Scheme systems to further give our royalty a helping hand!
[/list]
[h3]Improvements for 4-6 player games[/h3]
Some of our players liked navigating the uneasy power balance of 4-6 player games in 1.0, but others really didn’t enjoy it. We’ve addressed this with new options and features for smaller Party Games.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43052267/6edb95c0765417c090521df19bfc44b2b4b74e46.png[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Balance Solo Noble Votes[/b] - This optional feature boosts votes from solo Nobles pitted against larger teams, helping games of unequal players feel less imbalanced.
[*] [b]The Monarch’s Vote[/b] - We’ve removed Monarch’s Choice and replaced it with the Monarch’s Vote, which gives the Monarch a single vote. This gives the Monarch a buff in small games, and adds an extra element of strategy.
[/list]

[h3]Save sharing system[/h3]
Watching you all play KOTC has been a joy, and one thing we love is when players swap their save files at the end of their reigns, so that winning Nobles can take a turn playing the Monarch. We want to encourage this as much as possible, so now we’re making this easier than ever before.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43052267/db88d1e8827d7bf6d426c3257e77f2dccdc53435.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] Export your saves in the Continue Dynasty screen directly to our servers, which hold a copy of your game for 14 days.
[*] Import anyone’s saves by using the code given on the export screen and [b]start playing their game straight away![/b]
[*] IMPORTANT NOTE: you cannot import a Twitch Mode game as a Party Game or vice versa.
[/list]

[h3]New Events and content variation[/h3]
We’re pleased to be adding new stories to the game, as well both shortening and adding random variation to repeated Events.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43052267/694f885118ffb98a454bfb3fbf538e1871ec6f3b.png[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Claimants revamp[/b] - In response to feedback, Claimants now have introductions and are related to Nobles in content.
[*] [b]Variations to the Honour Guard event[/b] for subsequent playthroughs. Decide your Honour Guard in a battle royale, placate the High Inquisitor, or deal with a palace intruder!
[*] Certain repetitive events will now be shortened when you’re not playing the game for the first ever time (before, they would only be shortened in Dynasty games).
[*] New Event Chain - Gambling Tournament.
[*] New Rebellion Events - Pinch Point & Captured Loyalist.
[*] New Event - Pillar of the Community.
[/list]

[h3]Scheme and Event Rebalancing[/h3]
Using our analytics we monitor Schemes and Events, and will be constantly tweaking these in response to how they are being played.
[list]
[*] [b]New weighted Scheme selection system![/b] Blood Ritual, Ragnarok, Monopoly and Witch Hunt appear 40% less often, and Schemes that succeeded on one playthrough now won’t appear in a following Dynasty game.
[*] Ragnarok nerfed (Trade goal raised)
[*] Intimidation buffed (first stage is now Raise Stability)
[*] Conspiracy buffed (timers altered)
[*] Excommunication buffed (treasury and faith goals reduced)
[*] Avalanche now has an extra Stability requirement and will appear less
[*] What Lies Beneath has a lower requirement and will appear more
[*] New Apprentices has a slightly higher Stability requirement and will appear less
[*] Changed requirement for Terrible Accident
[*] Various other minor requirement tweaks
[/list]

[h3]Improvements to Dynasty Games[/h3]
We’ve had some great feedback about Dynasty Games and how they can feel imbalanced. The below changes, along with the revamped Claimants, will hopefully make your Dynasties even more fun.
[list]
[*] Reign-winning Schemes are no longer generated for that Region in the subsequent Dynasty reign.
[*] Nerfing winning Region stat gains on new Dynasty games.
[*] Foreign Mercenaries no longer increase Defiance but cost Authority.	
[*] Dynasty chain generation rebalancing - reign-based Event locking to prevent continuity errors and increase Event variety.
[/list]
[h3]Tooltips for Nobles and Schemes[/h3]
Observing games showed us that Monarchs often forget what Scheme is at what stage. Not any more! With new tooltips, you can not only view your Region’s Scheme’s progress, but your Nobles themselves.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43052267/b86a57560b23c23b8092f05f8c77b6a67ccd9b64.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] Hover over tooltips that show the Region Schemes, progress and aims.
[*] Hover over tooltips that show information and avatars of your Nobles in the Noble List, Voting screens and Building screens.
[/list]
[h3]30 new hats for Nobles[/h3]
You asked for hats? We got hats! 30 new available hats for premium players, from ushankas for the Barons to circlets for the Counts. [b]HATS.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43052267/acb254cb9ce53026d59d2d0c0aef4857de58aa3d.png[/img]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
1.1 has a range of bug fixes, both major and minor.
[list]
[*] Regions will sort Nobles into Regions equally even if players repeatedly leave and enter the game
Spouse divorce is now reflected in the end-game screen. You can no longer rewrite the past so your ex didn’t leave you.
[*] Fixed a bug where bidding on buildings doubles the amount bid.
[*] Scheme-related Buildings weren’t showing in rare cases, which is now resolved.
[*] Victory Book icon is now clickable (for a long time, players were confused why clicking the big obvious arrow, which practically screamed “click me”, did absolutely nothing).
[*] Improved retry system for web requests.
[*] Swing votes no longer break vote buckets UI.
[*] Building information fixed in kotc.app.
[*] Animation updates to stop visual errors.
[*] Improved icon for ambitions page.
[*] Rebalanced destroyed building stat changes.
[*] Fixed an issue in Morgana's Justice where you would switch combatants mid-fight if battling another Noble.
[*] Fixed an issue in Your Heir where adopted cousin Heirs prevent certain dialogue from displaying.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Honour Guard would incorrectly be referred to as dead, even though they’d merely resigned in disgrace.
[*] Fixed an issue where your relationship with the Pirate Queen could be discovered by… your ex-spouse, who presumably shouldn’t care at that point.
[*] Fixed various typos.
[/list]
[h3]Quality of life changes[/h3]
As well as all this, we’re keen to keep adding to King of the Castle and bring up the quality of the game. Here are some more minor tweaks that we couldn’t fit anywhere above!
[list] 
[*] UI change to expand the width of voting buckets in large games
[*] We’ve made tweaks to the Royal Gamble Law, which felt underpowered. It now adds 600 Treasury when it pays off, and only loses 200 Treasury if it fails.
[*] The palm trees have migrated to the South/the Coast where they belong. No more can you imagine Northerners in wolf pelts chilling beneath palm fronds.
[*] Credits update.
[*] We can’t stress this enough - Monarch’s Choice is dead. Long live Monarch’s Vote!
[/list]

[h2]What’s next for KOTC?[/h2]
We’re first going to keep an eye on Good To Be King. Our changes are careful but comprehensive, and we’ll track how it’s doing with your feedback and our analytics.

Speaking of which, don’t forget to join our Discord to let us know what you think of it and post any suggestions/feedback!

[url=https://discord.gg/CntxJ7wKDp][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43052267/00aca297720d043572cb96efbca852b7f211c7d4.gif[/img][/url]

We’ve already started work on our next update, which will be focused on adding a raft of new content and further quality of life features. We’re aiming to tackle some big requests, so keep them coming.

Thank you all again for playing and, again, if you’re enjoying King of the Castle and want to help us out, [b]please leave a review[/b].

We’d like to kick off by saying thank you so much for the response to King of the Castle on launch. Our team has been blown away by the love, support and sheer enthusiasm you’ve all shown!

Before we get started, we’d just like to call on you to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1839880/King_Of_The_Castle/]leave a review for the game[/url] if you haven’t already. The more reviews we get, the more kindly we’ll be treated by the algorithm and the more our community grows. It might only take you a minute, but it’ll make a huge difference!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1839880/King_Of_The_Castle/
All done? Good! Then let’s kick off with the patch notes for our newest version, v1.0.1:
[h2]Content Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed softlock on A Missing Noble during a Rebellion
[*] Fixed softlock on A Delicate Matter and divorce (thanks for Syrius on the Discord for this)
[*] The wall in Ragnarok now remembers its name in subsequent Dynasties - a big shout out to all Hadrian fans out there
[*] Revised the Bad Mushrooms Event - the mushrooms are as bad as ever, but the Nobles spend less time going on about it
[*] Fixed text for an ironic execution in which no noble gets executed
[*] The Boat Race Chain now completes in more cases
[*] Fixed dynasty edge cases where the Monarch could run out of gold in the first season, making any% speedruns exponentially harder
[*] Fixed crash if your spouse has an affair with a Chief named Helga (any other name worked fine, but Helga was too powerful for the game to contain her)
[*] Edge case handling for Mercenaries Leave event
[*] Reactivity treasury rebalance
[*] Requisitioning Rare Reagents no longer sends out a mystery Noble (Thanks to Smithian on the Discord for this)
[*] Missing Noble issue fixed in Begging for Scraps
[*] Duplicate characters/regions no longer appear in Covered In Brick (Thanks to Pinkly on the Discord for catching this) and Contested Wreck (Thanks to Smithian, TheLetterF and others on the Discord for this one)
[*] Typos fixed in An Embarrassing Problem, Boiling Point, A Kraken! and Carved Symbols
[*] The Stone Maiden will now appear to absolutely wreck your plans slightly less often
[*] Negative stat buildings (i.e. Stadiums) can now be haunted
[*] Fixed an issue that would cause fewer Event Chains from triggering, varying content more
[*] Various other smaller tweaks, fixes, incorrect pronouns, balance changes and spelling mistakes resolved[/list]
[h2]Tech Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Resolved issue with RNG seed setting that lead to games having similar Events
[*] Fixing issues with Event unlocks that are hiding some Events from players
[*] Clouds are now more confident and will not hide behind Region banners
[*] Resolved issue where Next Season button wouldn’t appear after playing all Events (thanks to The Strange Taco on our Discord for this)
[*] Story choice buttons now are unclickable until the animation completes
[*] Nobles are always cleared from the Join screen when backing out
[*] Building info tooltip in Party Game showing Twitch commands
[*] Shields in Vote Result now show correctly for Swing Vote Law
[*] Returned missing arrow for Continue Button on Vote screen
[*] Steam Rich presence Monarch name is now resolved
[*] Exceptions in Customization screen resolved[/list]
[h2]Polish[/h2]
[list]
[*] New animated trumpets on the vote closing screen
[*] Improved shader for Characters to stop jagged edges on some characters
[*] Moved down the Region Scheme Indicator under Treasury that caused overlaps
[*] Laws of the Land now are entirely clickable in Law purchase screen, rather than a small area on them
[*] A credits update[/list]
With those resolved, we’re confident the game is in a place where we can start working towards a bigger 1.1 update. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43052267/788f7038df2797e15c6ce7eca3aac2b438f6e0f9.png[/img]
[h2]Looking forward to 1.1[/h2]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1839880/view/3686797824786787283?l=english]
Our last blog post talked about this at length[/url], but if you didn’t read it, here’s a quick summary of the changes we’re making:

[h3]Buffing the Monarch[/h3]
[list][*] We’re going to tweak the balance in the Monarch’s favour slightly by buffing the Laws of the Land
[*] Specifically, we’re going to be re-examining the Monarch’s Choice
[*] The Ambition challenges will appear one turn earlier
[*] Improving the tools for the Monarch to reward or punish Nobles
[*] Rebalancing Region Schemes (Ragnarok, we’re coming for you)[/list]
We may not do all of these - We need to be very careful and avoid over-correction. Our aim is to keep it possible for the Regions to win, while tipping the scales in the Monarch’s favour.

[h3]Balance for small games[/h3]

We’re looking into ensuring games of 5 or 6 players don’t feel unbalanced, as well as continuing to improve Party Games.

[h3]Save Sharing[/h3]

We’re working on a system for easily sharing saves with other players, allowing a Noble from a winning region to take over as Monarch. We also plan to make Claimants more interesting and facilitate Dynasty Games in other ways.

[h3]Repeated Content[/h3]

We’re looking at varying more Event text, rebalancing Event generation and adding new Events, all with the aim of keeping multiple games feeling fresh.

A final warning - We’re a small team who are working extremely hard at the game, but the amount of things we’d like to do outweighs the amount of things we can do. Bear with us while we make King of the Castle even better - [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1839880/view/3686797824786787283?l=english]and before asking any questions, read last week’s blog post[/url], which goes into the above points in much greater detail.

notes.title: What's next for King of the Castle?
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43052267/abeef7a72ca80015ade6501db40a35ce80e0bad6.png[/img]

[h2]Post-Launch Reflections and Plans for the Future[/h2]

Well, [b]King of the Castle[/b] has been out for a week - and what a jam-packed, helter-skelter week it’s been! Almost as eventful as the first week of a Monarch’s reign…

First of all, and most importantly, we want to extend a massive [b]THANK YOU[/b] to everyone who’s bought the game and made this launch a success. Genuinely, the last week has been extraordinary and uplifting for this small passionate team who have been working on KOTC for so long, hoping it’d find its audience. And it has! We can’t express our gratitude deeply enough.

Now with your help, we can grow this community even further and kick off a new Golden Age for King of the Castle! 

If you’ve already bought the game and want to do us another huge favour, we’d like to ask you to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1839880/King_Of_The_Castle]leave a review[/url]. Reviews are super important to the Steam algorithm, so even if your review is short and sweet, it’s going to be vital to extending the game’s longevity.

Oh, and if you’re looking for a place to find groups of players who can join your KOTC games, look no further than [url=https://discord.gg/stY8SKyQWY]our Discord.[/url] We have multiple party rooms that are a hive of treachery and intrigue… Just as we like it!

Now, with the sappy stuff out of the way, let’s take a look back at how launch day went… And then we can discuss our plans for the future of the game. 

[h2]Launch Stats[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43052267/df41440ef279dcb8acb95db9105b0dbd21a40bef.png[/img]

We’ve been blown away by the response here! We should note some extras:
[list]
[*] We were in Steam ‘New & Trending’ for 6 days.
[*] Our Discord has grown by a thousand members.
[*] [url=https://www.nme.com/reviews/game-reviews/king-of-the-castle-review-3405666]We had a wonderful review in NME which you should read![/url]
[/list] 
[h2]What now?[/h2]

First of all, we want to ask for your patience. [b]King of the Castle is being developed by a small team[/b] with a limited capacity and tiny budget. When it comes to adding new stuff to the game, we need to be really careful about what we prioritize. 

This is complicated by the fact that this is a very experimental game - there’s nothing else [i]quite[/i] like it, which means there’s no pre-established formula. We need to be careful what we add, and make sure to do plenty of pre-update playtesting in case something fundamentally upsets the existing balance of the game.

So far, we’ve had a bounty of excellent feedback and suggestions, but if we wanted to implement even half of them it’d take us years. So we need to pick and choose carefully, but rest assured, your voice is still being heard - every bit of feedback we receive gets added to a big internal sheet, and we carefully track the most-requested features or adjustments.

There’s only two things we can regretfully be sure we won’t prioritize right now, despite much demand.

The first is [b]translations[/b] - the game has over 900,000 words, and each event features complex coding and variable tracking which would need to be changed to account for the different grammar of other languages. 

Much as we’d love to translate the game, it’d be a monumental task, and extremely expensive - King of the Castle just hasn’t reached that level of success yet. As soon as that changes, we’ll let you know and nobody will be happier than us.

The second thing we can’t offer is a [b]single player mode[/b], or the ability to add bot Nobles to the game - again, this would be a massive task, as King of the Castle was conceived as a purely multiplayer game from the very beginning and none of our code has been written to support a future addition like this. 

Our Tech team would have to work on nothing but this for many months, to the exclusion of all other features. We’ll never say [i]never,[/i] but we must regretfully say ‘not in the near future’.

There are a bunch of features we [i]can[/i] add, especially after hearing your loud and consistent feedback! More on that later. 

First off, our number one priority coming out of an intense launch week, is to release a hotfix which addresses the most serious bugs in the game. 

[h2]V1.01 Hotfix[/h2]

Here’s a brief overview of the bugs we’re fixing in the next update:
[list]
[*] We’ve had issues with Tutorials jumping around - apologies in particular to [b]Friends at the Table[/b] who saw this in their stream. That’s fixed!
[*] A few events, such as Contested Wreck, had double characters or had the same region twice. Thanks to Peps and Prunelle on the Discord for this one.
[*] In extremely rare cases, no Events would spawn. This was because of a clash in requirements in Stories, centered around the Spouse Divorce event. Yes, you could be divorced so hard it broke the game.
[*] We’ve fixed a crash if your spouse has an affair with a Chief named Helga. That’s one to rival the Dwarf Fortress patch notes.
[*] Nobles not clearing from the Join screen when going back from it. 
[*] Choices were clickable before they became visible. 
[*] Clouds were flying behind Region banners. Not any more - now the clouds stay in the sky where they belong.
[*] Numerous other small fixes to dozens of events, as well as smattering of spelling and grammar mistakes!
[/list]
This is just the topline however, and the team are feverishly working on more. [b]Expect this hotfix out early next week[/b].

[h2]Our focus for the future[/h2]

Once this patch is out, what will we do?

Well, probably more bugfixes. Bugs are the worst kinds of enemies - they endlessly respawn and you don’t even get XP for grinding them. But what else?

We’ve heard your feedback loud and clear (Sam’s feedback sheet is running into hundreds of lines!) and are working on a new update which aims to respond to the feedback we've been getting. 

[b]Please note this is not a comprehensive list of things we want to update in King of the Castle![/b] If you don't see your 'must have' feature on here, it doesn't mean we don't want to do it.

The first issue we hope to address is…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43052267/a9272a9089667607642111eb36ac08acf37a05a4.png[/img]
[h3]Monarchs feeling powerless[/h3]

[b]Our highest priority feedback to address is that our Monarchs are feeling underpowered![/b]

While we need to make sure Regions have a chance at winning and players do find losing fun in KOTC, we also want to give the Monarch a fighting chance!

From 0.10 to 1.0 we saw a 10% drop in Monarch victories in our analytics. This is bigger than it sounds. While it’s partly due to an influx of new players who are unfamiliar with how the game works, there’s definitely some other balance issues here. We’re going to make some changes to give our Monarchs a helping hand.

 (But while we think rebalancing is necessary, we want to emphasize that it [i]is[/i] currently possible for a sufficiently skilled Monarch to reliably win the game, even with bad RNG! [url=https://www.twitch.tv/videos/1755970992]Check out Spofie’s stream if you don’t believe it[/url] or [url=https://discord.gg/CntxJ7wKDp]have a look at our Discord, where victorious Monarchs are touting their skills[/url])

Here’s what we’re looking into:
[list]
[*] [b]Laws of the Land[/b] - these are one of the most important things in the Monarch’s toolbox, so by buffing them slightly, we can make a big difference. We’re going to change them to be available slightly earlier in the game, and we’re also going to look at changing one specific Law…
[*] The [b]Monarch’s Choice[/b], which currently is purely cosmetic. Changing it to have a gameplay impact may radically alter the balance of the game too far in the Monarch’s favour, so we need to be careful. We’ll tell you more about our plans once we’ve done some playtesting
[*] Players are feeling like their [b]Ambitions are taking too long to show[/b] in the endgame. We’re taking a look at tweaking this, which will also help with feedback we’ve had about the game running long
[*] [b]Rebellions![/b] They hit hard, which is the design intention, but right now they’re happening a little too frequently. We’re attacking this from multiple angles and will report back after our initial testing is done
[*] Giving [b]Monarchs improved tools to reward or punish Nobles[/b], to help them get the Votes and win the Nobles to their side
[*] Making sure Region's Schemes are well balanced and a wider variety are chosen by Regions.
[/list]
We need to be really, really, really careful about balance with this one. Previous versions of King of the Castle were too difficult for the Nobles and were simply not fun. The current balance is likely a result of over-correcting and now we have analytics from thousands of games we can more accurately balance KOTC. 

The last thing we want is to go back to the Nobles being powerless - hence our caution. This is going to take time, a number of careful changes and most of all, a lot of testing internally.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43052267/4cac5c2f02e96ede4e723208a48c1f70afbee01d.png[/img]
[h3]Balance for small games[/h3]

Next, we’ve received repeated feedback that games of 5 and 6 feel unbalanced, due to the voting disparity. At games of 8 or more, this is felt less keenly, as it’s more difficult for bigger regions to coordinate.

We’re looking at ways of [b]leveling the playing field for all players in those games[/b], while still preserving the style of play that many players like. In general, we’re aware that players have issues with small games and we’re going to do something to fix it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43052267/0dac4897a9cb69c0d4405c9c5b55925364ee9f64.png[/img]
[h3]Save Sharing[/h3]

We’re learning a lot about how players play King of the Castle. It’s one thing to design, test and playtest, it’s another to have thousands of players jump in.

Something we’re picked up on is that Nobles want to take over as the Monarch after winning the game. We’ve heard your feedback about [b]replacing Claimants with a Noble, but this isn’t something we can do without a major rewrite of the game[/b] - especially as in 4 to 6 player games the Claimant appears in Scheme stories.

However, we have some plans for supporting this way of playing King of the Castle. Here’s what we’re looking at changing:

[list]
[*] Making it easier to share save files so Nobles from a winning Region can take over as Monarch in the following dynasty game
[*] Making Claimants more interesting for players
[*] A number of balance changes to Dynasty games to ensure one Region doesn’t permanently rule the roost.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43052267/0001524e8ba297105721cd66f84a3a3be6709abd.png[/img]
[h3]Repeated Content[/h3]

Next on our list is repeated content in the game. This can be split into two bits of feedback: First, that the unchanging early-game events such as the Honour Guard selection are proving repetitive, and second, that some of the other emergent events are showing up too often in the game.

First things first - the early game. We had expected that ongoing Dynasties would be a big part of players’ campaigns. In the later reigns of a Dynasty, early events are shortened for ease of reading. It turns out that we misjudged this - many players prefer to start a whole new game.

There’s multiple angles to attack this problem. We want to make Dynasty games more appealing - currently, people have been complaining of a lack of balance. We also have plans to make the early game events much more varied.

Next - repeated events in the core game. Events are generated semi-randomly, with RNG influenced by the Kingdom stats and various other factors. We keep a very close eye on event generation in our analytics, and we’re going to do some rebalancing based off that. 

We’re also going to add new Events to the game, as well as take a look at how Schemes are currently being generated. We’d like to do new Schemes too, but these require some serious testing and balancing, so no promises.

But we also have to ask for some understanding here - in a game with pure RNG, it’s just a law of probability that you’ll see some events multiple times. We have 950+ events in the game and over 900,000 words of content, but even if we doubled this tomorrow, you’d still be getting the same events occasionally. Each storyline can go in dramatically different directions, so embrace the chaos and seek out lesser-seen consequences!

[b]Changes to address the above points will be all be rolled into our 1.1[/b]. It's early days but we'll let you know soon as we can when it's coming out.

[h2]A final thank you![/h2]

And that’s it - these are going to be our focus for the immediate future. If you have your own feedback let us know directly by [url=https://discord.gg/stY8SKyQWY]joining our Discord[/url] and posting your feedback in the #kotc-suggestions-feedback channel.

Oh, and one more thing - please remember to leave a review. The Steam algorithm is like a forgetful god, terrifying in its indifference. But with your help, we can force it to sit up and pay attention.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1839880/King_Of_The_Castle

Happy reigns!

notes.title: Thousands can scheme against you in political sim King Of The Castle
notes.notes:
At first glance, King Of The Castle might look similar to other medieval political sims; something like Reigns or Yes, Your Grace, where you ascend the throne, rule a kingdom, and make decisions that will impact your gold reserves, military strength, or alliances. That political manoeuvring is intact in King Of The Castle, but this time up to 24 of your friends (or thousands of Twitch viewers) can join your campaign, hopping into the shoes of nobles from various regions. All of them have different goals, all of them can vote on certain decisions, and all of them have the potential to support or backstab the all-powerful monarch: you.

notes.title: Finding Games, Faith & Feature Reveal
notes.notes:
Not long now - King of the Castle is out [b]TOMORROW[/b]! Have you wishlisted yet?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1839880/King_Of_The_Castle/

Later in today’s update, we’re going to talk about the different religions of your Kingdom. But first of all, I’m aware that we’re getting a bunch of new eyeballs on this page this week, so I wanted to go through exactly how this game is played.

In King of the Castle, [b]one player is the Monarch[/b] and multiple other players form their council of Nobles. 

Monarchs host [b]Party Games[/b] for 3-24 Nobles who join on browsers for free, or use [b]Twitch Mode[/b], where an unlimited number of followers play as Nobles directly in chat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43052267/e777cfe385bd5e4b6dd7cfdcb3b3e21a9c7f924a.png[/img]

[h1]Finding Games[/h1]

King of the Castle is a multiplayer game, first and foremost. It can be played by 4 to 4000 people (though realistically, there's no upper limit!).

If you want to play a game - with your D&D group, board game club, friend circle or local chapter of monks - it literally couldn’t be easier. 

[b]Only one person - the Monarch - needs to actually own the game.[/b] Everyone else can join [b]FOR FREE[/b] via browser (so make sure there’s Wi-Fi in the monastery) at [url=kotc.app]kotc.app[/url] and needs to be able to see the Monarch’s screen.	

We’ve found that Discord is perfect for this, but any video call software should work! We have our very own Discord where you can use the [b]looking-for-game[/b] channel and type [b]@looking for game ping[/b] to find others to play with. Come join us here:

[url=https://discord.gg/CntxJ7wKDp][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43052267/00aca297720d043572cb96efbca852b7f211c7d4.gif[/img][/url]

Alternatively, you can jump on Twitch and find someone streaming the game. If you own the game, you can [b]join with your unique customised character[/b], who will be more likely to star in ongoing storylines!

Now we’ve gone over the basics, let’s dive deeper into the lore of the Kingdom. Have you heard the good word… The word about the Ninth?

[h1]Matters of Faith[/h1]

This time, we’re talking about the different religions of Celest Ath!

[h2]i. The Ninth God[/h2]

The majority religion within the Kingdom is semi-monotheistic and worships the [b]Ninth God[/b].  Their doctrine teaches that once upon a time, there were eight gods, who created a flawed world full of sinful people. Then the Ninth God willed Himself into existence and banished or destroyed the other eight, punishing them for the faults in their creation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43052267/93213e3e16987b7250050ebe8de2615a87f508a9.png[/img]

Now the Ninth God is striving to fix the mistakes of His predecessors, and it is only through worship that we can persuade Him not to destroy us all and start again. Those who worship Him and live a good life will be taken to the Thereafter - the world He will make after ours is destroyed, which will finally be perfect. Non-believers face oblivion, while especially evil souls will be condemned to join the other gods in one of the Seven Hells.

It is orthodoxy that the Hells are ruled by the Seventh God, who the Ninth merely banished rather than destroyed, and are populated by demons and devils who serve as the Seventh’s servants. These servile demons are believed to be fragments of the Fifth God, sprouting from cinders after the Fifth was burned.

Though the Monarch does not lead the Church of the Ninth, they are considered to have a divine right to rule, deriving their earthly power from the Ninth God Himself.

The Church of the Ninth is led by an [b]Archbishop[/b], who resides in the Capital City, within [b]St. Bertrand’s Cathedral[/b]. Functionally the Archbishop’s role is similar to that of a Pope - he is considered to be a vessel for the will of the Ninth, and is hugely powerful in his own way. 

The Church of the Ninth also maintains an active [b]Inquisition[/b], which actively roots out heresy and ‘devil-worship.’ It is led by a [b]High Inquisitor[/b], who is subordinate within the Church only to the Archbishop himself. The Inquisitors love to burn people alive for witchcraft or heresy, and they are (reputably) impossible to bribe. As a result, even Nobles live in fear of attracting the Inquisitors’ attention - especially the Counts of the East, who have one or two things to hide.

[h2]ii. The Old Gods of the North[/h2]

The [b]North[/b] is considered a ‘pagan’ country - they don’t deny the existence of the Ninth, only His suitability for worship. Instead, they worship a pantheon of dozens of squabbling ‘old gods’. A priest of the Northern religion is known as a ‘godspeaker’.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43052267/41501fd7c41daf6b791c57e0e8f58cdc75ae0012.png[/img]

The Church is engaged in a perpetual campaign to introduce Ninthism to the North, sending legions of missionaries to the furthest reaches and highest mountains. Most of them end up hanging from a tree or inside a winter wolf’s stomach, but they have been having some gradual success, and more and more Northerners have begun converting thanks to the Church’s efforts. This is a great worry to the Chiefs, who have kept Ninthism at bay for centuries and sacrificed a lot to secure special protections for their faith in the laws of the Kingdom.

The foremost deity among Northerners is [b]Morgana[/b], the Witch of Three, the Mother of Mountains, the Ageless Crone. She appears in the form of an old woman, a young maiden, or a mother with baby, or sometimes all at once. She also often appears in the form of an owl, a raven, or a goose. 

There are dozens of other gods, most notably:

[list]
[*][b]Valtor[/b], the Lord of Battle, the Twice-Killed, the Flayer of Stars.
[*][b]Knelquiss[/b], the Trickster King, the Dancer-in-the-Flame, the Oathbreaker.
[*][b]Odheld[/b], the Drunken Vessel, the Honey-blooded Prince, the Hornblower.
[*][b]Chalith[/b], the Harvester, the Flesh-Feaster, the Lady of Red Banquets.
[*][b]Grahala[/b], the Forged Maiden, the Iron Exile, the Smithqueen.
[*][b]Skurinorn[/b], the Locked Casket, the Poison Augur, the Guardian of Runes.
[/list]

[h2]iii. The Deposed Gods[/h2]

The [b]Deposed Gods[/b] are the Eight Gods who were defeated by the Ninth in a terrible war after He willed Himself into existence to save the world from its creators. This moment was known as the [b]Ninth’s Triumph[/b].

Worshippers of the Ninth refer to the period of the Eight Gods’ hegemony as the [b]Cursed Age[/b]. The game’s calendar starts at 948 - the Kingdom is counting from year 0, where the Cursed Age ended and the Ninth God was finally victorious.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43052267/a374b2196e57b9203e3bf81ada602daf27b49c8d.png[/img]

The official teachings of the Ninth Church is that the Eight were each defeated in different ways:

[list]
[*]The [b]First [/b]vanished upon the Ninth’s arrival, and was never seen again;
[*]The [b]Second [/b]was exiled after most of his power was stolen by the Ninth, and now wanders the world as a sad and powerless creature;
[*]The [b]Third [/b]was drowned in the darkest depths of the ocean, where her ghost still lingers;
[*]The [b]Fourth [/b]was eaten by the Ninth and the Sixth in a grand banquet;
[*]The [b]Fifth [/b]was burned to ash, which scattered across the world, causing demons to spring from the land which flocked to serve the Seventh;
[*]The [b]Sixth [/b]who had thought herself allied with the Ninth in his war, helped him devour the Fourth - but the Ninth fed her a poisoned seed, causing flowers to blossom within her and kill her;
[*]The [b]Seventh [/b]was banished to the Hells, along with all his demonic followers, where he still plots the Ninth’s downfall to this day;
[*]The [b]Eighth [/b]was torn into eight pieces and buried deep beneath the earth.
[/list]

Common folk remember the fates of the Eight with an old schoolyard rhyme - 

[i]	“Eight dark Gods, lords of hellfire,
Three would live and five expire;
The First, the coward, fled and vanished, 
The Seventh, the rebel, beaten and banished;
The Second wanders, now depowered;
The Third was drowned, the Fourth devoured;
The Fifth burned while the Sixth bloomed; 
And the Eighth, asunder, lies entombed.”[/i]

[h2]iv. Ashmedean Religion[/h2]

The Ashmedeans worship [b]Kaldovaga[/b], the Machine God, the Negligent One, the Worldsmith, who built the world from spare parts lying around his workshop, then put it on a high shelf and forgot about it. 

They believe that the world is slowly falling apart, and Kaldovaga will only repair it if humanity worships him in a great enough quantity to attract His attention once again. In Ashmedean society, all priests double as blacksmiths and engineers, and the building of bridges or forging of swords is as much a holy ritual as it is a craft.

The Ashmedean Empire makes frequent use of [b]golems[/b], constructs built of clay or iron which can tirelessly perform simple tasks, manual labour, or combat. Golems are built in church-factories by priests of Kaldovaga.

[h1]Voting UI Update[/h1]

Now that you're feeling suitably spiritually nourished, it's time to talk about one last feature we're introducing in v1.0: The new Voting Screen! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43052267/ba02c7cf58669f3aca9168e4f7261c8d9d9fc167.png[/img]

We've had some great feedback about readability in this screen. The text was simply too small, especially when watching someone else's screen!

This new update aims to solve this; Firstly, the [b]Vote Setup screen[/b] now spaces out votes properly and widens them, increasing text size, and our Laws have been redesigned to better show off all the options at your disposal. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43052267/414d169afe4176af7d54a592711ffe75b8c23fca.png[/img]

Votes themselves have a new lighter, higher contrast background, and also [b]display any active Laws[/b] set by the Monarch, This will help unsuspecting victims of Laws like Reverse Voting or the new Call For Unity not get caught out. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43052267/225fb9028723744cbffa56b2b58bdb1b6a7146d2.gif[/img]

We hope you're excited for this and the other features we've been previewing in our previous blog posts. Read this one for the most exciting new additions we've added in the past month or two!

Tomorrow we're finally out, and with it will come a Launch Day blog post to remember - Packed to the gills with new features, bugfixes and Events. 

If you're interested in hopping on a game to check out KOTC, why not watch some of our launch day streams? See our schedule over the next few days below:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43052267/afacb23de9f40460f7dc8052ef857f163d042f38.png[/img]

See you tomorrow for your coronation...

notes.title: Game Stats & Geography of Celest Ath
notes.notes:
The time for your coronation is nigh - We have six days until [b]King of the Castle[/b] comes out on Steam!

So what do you get for $4.99? A lot of game! Read on to find out...

But first, if you haven't wishlisted King of the Castle yet, please do. That way you'll be the first to find out when we release.

You're also giving us a full suit of plate armour with which we can wage mortal combat with the deadly Steam algorithm. Metaphorically.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1839880/King_Of_The_Castle

Thank you! Right, let's get down to brass tacks. What's inside your Kingdom?

[h2]King of the Castle Launch Stats[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43052267/ccbd03bff13e46301c8f719349fdb8e3981cfe9d.png[/img]

And that's mentioning less than 30% of the new features, changes and fixes we're adding for our very special 1.0 version! 

But more on them later, because it's time for another dip into the lore of our game...

[h2]World Geography[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43052267/ab66598f12d856ca4489ce0349af3e181442b5a7.png[/img]
[h3]The Kingdom[/h3]

The main focus of every player’s game is [b]the Kingdom[/b], which has no specific name. The Kingdom changes from playthrough to playthrough, and will consist of 3 different regions selected at game start. Over the course of the game, the Kingdom will change to reflect the player’s decisions, and the Kingdom can entirely transform over the course of a player’s Dynasty.

The Kingdom can be considered equivalent in size to both France and Germany slammed together - ~1,000,000 square km or ~600,000 square miles. It’s bigger than Texas but much smaller than the entire United States.

The Kingdom and the Frozen Wastes occupy the continent known as [b]North Ithos[/b]. The Ashmedean Empire, Tavallin and (further south) the Endless Plains occupy the continent of [b]South Ithos[/b]. Across the Ghost Sea lies the continent of [b]Elrusia[/b].

The Kingdom is very cold in the North and the East, much warmer in the South, and temperate everywhere else.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43052267/1a8f46767ce361b0e1e74e3fe9708497e2044de4.png[/img]
[h3]Bordering Nations[/h3]

To the north, the Kingdom borders an expansive territory of uninhabitable ice and tundra, known as the [b]Frozen Wastes[/b]. The Wastes are notoriously dangerous - they are populated with barbarian tribes, ice giants, winter wolves, polar bears, and wyverns. The most likely thing to kill you, though, is the brutal weather.

To the south-west, the Kingdom borders the [b]Ashmedean Empire[/b], a vast, powerful and ancient Empire that views the Kingdom as an irritating upstart in world affairs. Nine hundred years ago, starting from the central city-state of Ashmede, the Empire expanded outwards and conquered several much larger countries, seeming unstoppable. A mountain range known as the [b]Daggertops[/b] forms a natural border between the Empire and the Kingdom, preventing the Kingdom from being conquered in similar fashion.

The current [b]Emperor Shemorath II[/b] is weak, cruel and irrational. As a result the Empire has largely fallen under control of a few powerful Generals. Nowadays, the Empire is a decaying relic of its former glory, more concerned with endless internal squabbling than conquering others… although it’s still terrifyingly powerful when roused to anger.

Nevertheless, the Ashmedeans remember the days when they could have conquered the world, and maintain a proud military tradition (even if the army these days is corrupt and despised by the commonfolk). They will always be a threat to the Kingdom - if a stronger Emperor ever ascends to the throne and turns his eye north, the resultant war could be devastating.

Also to the south-east, the Kingdom borders [b]Tavallin[/b], a new kingdom that only reclaimed its independence from the Ashmedean Empire a half-century ago. Tavallin, lacking the military might of its neighbours and constantly fearing invasion, relies on spies and intrigue to get ahead. The Tavallinese despise the Ashmedeans, and the feeling is mutual - but the Tavallinese also fear the Kingdom, and their spies permeate every Region, constantly rooting out secrets that can be turned to Tavallin’s advantage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43052267/1954e25bc39cd1f6b92f490d0eb4784aff049d53.png[/img]
[h3]Across the Sea[/h3]

Across the Ghost Sea from the Kingdom is the vast continent of [b]Elrusia[/b], bigger than South Ithos and North Ithos put together. The majority of Elrusia is taken up by the wild, untamed lands of [b]Valamyr[/b] and the great deserts of [b]Aatesh[/b].

However, a number of smaller, more urbanised nations cluster on the eastern coastline of Elrusia, trading (and warring) with the Kingdom. These include [b]the Republic of Kirth[/b], a technologically-advanced republic that boasts plentiful gunpowder and despises Monarchs; [b]Danea[/b], a tiny and insignificant city-state with a democratic government; and several others.

Just off the eastern coast of Elrusia lies the [b]Isle of Saal[/b], a cheerfully lawless island about the size of Iceland, with a mostly-deserved reputation as a haven for pirates and brigands of all kinds. 

Far to the east from the Kingdom is an even larger and more mysterious continent, known as the [b]Vastness of Chur[/b]. The ocean that separates it from the Kingdom is known as the [b]Eastern Sea[/b].

[h3]1.0 Feature Reveal - Improved Event Generation![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43052267/84e584c78310076e6c10fd90d734bcafb5ff6fd9.gif[/img]

That list above is far from everything we're adding to King of the Castle for launch! 

We'll be revealing more on March 2nd but there's one change we couldn't wait to share: [b]Our New Event Generation System[/b]!

It might not seem as exciting something like Events that carry over multiple Dynasties, new Laws of the Land, a ton of new content, or a heap of new outfits... [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1839880?emclan=103582791472573675&emgid=3636129793133277317]But we just happen to already be going all that anyway![/url]. 

What these changes have done is has fundamentally altered the way King of the Castle [i]feels[/i] compared to our previous builds, and solidly for the better.

Here's what's happening in 1.0 with this new system:
[list]
[*] [b]Events have more variety[/b] - by introducing a system that spaces our 'Event Chains' (Events that directly related to one another), a greater variety of Events can be generated in a game. In testing this has dramatically reduced the number of repeated Events and increased the chance of seeing rarer Events, including those related to Schemes or Ambitions; A double win.
[*] [b]Events are more evenly spread[/b] - If your Region doesn't get an Event generated in a Season, the game increases the likelihood of that happening next Season. This was a tough one to balance, but has now lead to even more variety in stories and an equal look-in for all Regions.
[*] [b]Events have even more reactivity[/b] - A huge number of new 'Misdeeds' have been painstakingly added to the game. These track choices across multiple stories, making games even more reactive to your decisions and your Noble's votes.
[*] [b]Events react to past Events[/b] - Special Events and vote options now show up in a Dynasty Games that are determined by how the last game ended. This has helped make Dynasty Games feel more responsive to past choices, especially with the Dynasty Event system we're introducing.
[*] [b]The game is even more balanced[/b] - Testing, analytics and watching a [i]lot[/i] of streams have given us some great insights into the game's balance. 1.0 has had a major re-balance of a number of Events and Schemes to give a better feel to the game. Games are tighter, less predictable and have less Regions left behind by low performing Schemes.
[*] [b]A ton of new Events![/b] - We added new Events throughout the game. Some are new Dynasty Events, others full Chain Events (like the Whims of Wizards Event Chains) and a host of standard, one-off Events. Some of these are targeted at resolving balance issues, but are chiefly there to add narrative flavour, variety and interesting scenarios to navigate!
[/list]

We'll be sharing more updates on 1.0 on our Discord, including showing off the brand new customisations for Regions and exclusive Twitch Drop outfits. See you there!
